cohort: four-molecule production subcohort (DMC, EMC, GBL, SL)

localization_basis.closed_shell: Li Mulliken charge share (denominator total charge)

quantity_discipline: Li-donor distance (Angstrom) and Li-donor Mayer bond order are different quantities in different columns; a missing Li bond order means the contact is weaker than ORCA's print floor, not zero

frontier_localization.fix: add an ORCA orbital-population print key when the production inputs are next regenerated, then re-run this builder

note: pre-registered conventions for a resource-bounded cohort, not calibrated constants; a state inside the boundary band, or one whose Mulliken and Loewdin partitions disagree, is reported as ambiguous rather than forced into a class
